method.onsets: Positive log-STFT spectral flux, 1024 samples / 240-hop (5ms), separated by >=65ms. STFT timestamps are window centers and not sample-accurate attack starts.
method.kick: Independent drum-stem waveform peak after each scheduled kick; musical grid is not inferred from these peaks.
method.listening: Not listened to by the authoring agent. Signal QA cannot certify musical taste, timbre or the final interaction with engine/dialogue audio.
